# Women and the Right to Vote

<!-- STEP id="long-struggle" -->
## A Long Struggle Elsewhere

In a number of countries, women had a long and difficult struggle for the vote. It came in **1920** in the USA, and full voting rights came only in **1928** in Britain, after decades of protests and movements.

<!-- STEP id="from-1950" -->
## India: From 1950

When the Constitution came into force in **1950**, Universal Adult Franchise was extended to all citizens, men and women alike, from its first day. Indian women did not have to engage in prolonged battles for the vote.

<!-- STEP id="not-automatic" -->
## A Right Is Not Yet Equality

The right to vote does not automatically ensure equal participation. Social prejudices still act as barriers and affect women's representation in politics.

**Having a right and being able to use it fully are different things.**
